name: Barbell Wide-Grip Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your front shoulders using a wider-than-usual overhand grip.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs tightly, and tuck your chin slightly back.
Press the bar straight overhead until both arms extend cleanly above your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly down in front of your face back to your front shoulders.
tips: Avoid leaning backward to move the bar past your chin.
Keep your wrists straight directly above your forearms throughout the press.
